about.name: Sri Lanka rupee, prices and CBSL

public.in_one_sentence: Changes in Sri Lanka's policy rate, rupee, inflation, fuel prices or IMF programme that move what the bank earns, pays or must report.
tell_me_if: CBSL changes its policy rate, reserve requirement or issues a new direction to banks
The rupee moves more than 2% against the dollar in a week
Ceylon Petroleum Corporation or the government revises fuel or electricity prices
Inflation, reserves or the external position are reported to have changed direction
The IMF announces a review result, delay or conditions for Sri Lanka
ignore: Opinion pieces about the economy with no new data

match.headline: Central Bank raises policy rate by 100 basis points to 8.75 percent
Rupee weakens past 335 to the dollar
Ceylon Petroleum Corporation raises petrol and diesel prices
IMF staff reach agreement on next review for Sri Lanka

exposure.how_it_reaches_us: Deposit rates follow the policy rate.

serious: CBSL announces a moratorium or relief direction to banks
private.notes: Inflation reached 8% in August, the policy rate was raised to 8.75% in May, and the rupee has moved both ways this year (about 331 to the dollar on 15 October).
